surface: Codex in-app browser, localhost Vite development preview
conclusion: Foreground performance is not established. Scheduling varied substantially; the two latest runs showed an approximately 1000 ms callback cadence while the browser visibility API reported false. A request to show the review was queued by the application. Neither the earlier high callback rate nor the hidden runs establish foreground game FPS.

limits: Actual World rendering with three display karts following the existing circuit; full race AI and network are not running.
requestAnimationFrame and JavaScript timing, not a GPU timer query or display-present measurement.
Browser visibility is sampled through the browser API outside the run, not on every animation frame. The fixed one-second cadence is consistent with background throttling; it is not a GPU diagnosis.
The preview counts intervals whose end occurs after two seconds, so a long interval crossing the warmup boundary can enter the sample. JavaScript render-call median includes warmup calls.
The application could not present the current task's browser panel during the final measurement. A foreground full-game performance check remains outstanding.
